) on Friday said it has entered into an accelerated share repurchase agreement with Deutsche Bank AG, London Branch for $200 million of its common stock.
As of Oct. 30, 2026, the company has $17 million of remaining availability under the 2025 repurchase plan and $600 million of remaining availability under the 2026 repurchase plan.

Under the terms of the ASR, HGV will pay the repurchase price and receive common stock with an aggregate value of 80% based on the closing share price of the company's common stock as of Oct. 29, 2026. This represents approximately 4.48 million shares based on the Oct. 29, 2026 closing price of $35.71.
The final settlement of the ASR is expected to be completed by Dec. 31, 2026.

title: Hilton Grand Vacations announces $200M accelerated share repurchase
